verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API-only onboarding: you make API requests to create resources and submit user data, the Legal Entity Management API manages legal entities, and the Configuration API creates balance accounts. An agent could therefore create and onboard sellers programmatically. An official MCP server exists, but the evidence never says it covers platform seller operations, and requirements-due handling and scoped credentials are undocumented. Missing for 10: evidence of answering requirements-due or verification states, scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents, MCP server coverage of onboarding and account operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run seller operations — create accounts, drive onboarding to completion, and answer requirements-due states through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Build your own UI and collect required user data. You make API requests to create resources and submit the user data to Adyen.
To manage legal entities, use the Legal Entity Management API.
You can create balance accounts manually using the Configuration API.
